capabilities: Generate package, crate, and module index pages from Cargo workspace metadata
Create per-item Markdown pages for structs, enums, traits, functions, macros, and more
Link items to source files and stable block targets in the vault
Configure per-project profiles with packages, targets, and features
Protect and clean up generated files using an ownership manifest
extras: Desktop-only (Obsidian 1.8+); mobile intentionally unsupported. Not yet in the community catalog; manual install required. README warns the code was fully AI-generated and advises reviewing it and testing in a separate vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn local Rust project documentation into navigable, linked Markdown notes.

relations.evidence: It reads Cargo workspace metadata and nightly rustdoc JSON, then creates package/module indexes

requires.name: cargo and nightly Rust (rustdoc JSON) on PATH

summary: Rust API documentation generator that runs local Cargo/rustdoc to create linked Markdown pages for crates, modules, and API items in the vault.
